label: Arista 720XP-24Y6
description: Arista CCS-720XP-24Y6 - 1RU Cognitive Campus PoE leaf: 24x 1G RJ45 @ 30W (Ethernet1-24) and 6x 25G SFP28 uplinks (Ethernet25-30). 583 W of PoE with the single 650 W supply it ships with.

poe.note: Arista CCS-720XP data sheet, "Power Supply Models (1G Platforms)" table, 720XP-24Y6 column: "Default Power Supply 650 W" and "1Default Available PoE Power (Typ/Min) 583 W / 560 W". 583 W is the typical-load figure for the shipped single supply; 1136/1113 is the dual-650W row and 883/860 the dual-500W-DC row.

notes: Census from the Arista sheet, read 2026-11-24. Product Highlights: "24x 10M-1GbE RJ45 @ 30W / Uplinks: 6x 25G". The 1G Platforms specification table gives Ports "48 RJ45 / 6 25G SFP" for the 48Y6 and "24 RJ45 / 6 25G SFP" for this model, with 10M-1G UTP (30W 802.3af/at) = 24 and 100G QSFP = N/A; the uplink row reads "1G or 10G or 25G SFP" = 6, which is where the SFP28 speedCaps come from. Ordering information: "CCS-720XP-24Y6-F Arista 720XP, 24 x 10/100M-1G PoE, 6 x 25G SFP switch, front to rear air, 1 x 650W AC".
